listing.name: NAM (NAPALM) (Rednukem)
listing.summary: Play NAM (NAPALM) through Rednukem using your own matching game files.

steps.title: Extract the matching Windows player
steps.instruction: Choose the rednukem_win64 archive. Extract the complete archive to a folder for this game and keep rednukem.exe with its packaged files.

steps.title: Add your game files to this copy
steps.instruction: For NAM, use NAM.GRP, NAM.RTS and the CON files from your own installation. For NAPALM, keep its NAPALM.GRP, NAPALM.RTS and NAPALM.CON together in a separate folder. Keep the original copy separately.

steps.title: Run setup and play again
steps.instruction: Use the extracted folder as the working directory and start rednukem.exe with -usecwd. Complete the startup window if it opens. After saving a working configuration, try -nosetup for direct Play. Use -setup to reopen the startup settings.

references.title: Keep the game folder and its saves
references.instruction: With -usecwd, keep the game folder, settings and saved data together. Back up this folder before replacing a working copy with a newer upstream release. You manage replacement and backups for this upstream copy.
